questions.question: If a friend has been drinking and wants to ride their motorcycle, what should you do?

options.text: Tell them to use less-crowded roads.
Ask other friends to help stop them from riding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Ask other friends to help stop them from riding.
questions.explanation: Never allow someone to ride if they have been drinking. Do everything you can to prevent them from riding. Get other friends to help talk them out of it.

questions.question: Which item is NOT protective clothing for a motorcycle rider?
questions.explanation: Wear protective clothing when riding a motorcycle. Good protective gear includes sturdy jackets and pants that cover your arms and legs completely, boots or heavy shoes that cover your ankles, and sturdy gloves.

questions.question: If you feel tired while riding, what should you do?

options.text: Keep riding and hope you wake up.
Ride on the shoulder of the road.

questions.explanation: Do not ride when you are tired. On long rides, take a break at least every two hours to avoid fatigue.

questions.question: Motorcycle riders should wear shoes with soles that are:
questions.explanation: Choose riding boots or shoes that are tall and sturdy enough to cover and support your ankles. The soles should be hard, durable, and slip-resistant.

questions.question: What happens when you take a corner too fast on a motorcycle?

options.text: You may drift into another lane.
It is better than going too slowly.
You will usually stay in your lane.
It is fine because motorcycles are smaller than other vehicles.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may drift into another lane.
questions.explanation: Taking a turn too fast may cause you to cross into another lane or go off the road. Always slow down before you enter a turn or curve.

questions.question: What types of brakes do most motorcycles have?
questions.explanation: Most motorcycles have one brake for each wheel. The front brake is more powerful than the rear brake.

questions.question: To get the best protection, wear a helmet that:
questions.explanation: Choose a helmet that meets U.S. Department of Transportation (DOT) and state standards. It should fit snugly all the way around with no visible damage.

questions.question: How should you use your mirrors when riding?

options.text: Check them regularly as part of your normal riding routine.
Avoid checking them because they distract you.
Avoid checking them because other drivers can see you easily.
Check them only in bad weather.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check them regularly as part of your normal riding routine.
questions.explanation: For your safety, know what is behind you at all times. Check your mirrors often as part of your normal riding routine.

questions.question: What is the best source of information about your specific motorcycle?

options.text: Someone who rides a different type of motorcycle.
A television show about motorcycle riding.

questions.explanation: Read the owner's manual before riding any motorcycle for the first time. This is especially important if you are riding a borrowed motorcycle.

questions.question: What clothing should you wear when riding a motorcycle?

options.text: Clothing that covers your arms and legs completely.
Clothing that covers your arms but leaves your legs exposed.
Clothing that covers your legs but leaves your arms exposed.
Whatever is most comfortable, regardless of safety.

questions.correctAnswerText: Clothing that covers your arms and legs completely.
questions.explanation: For proper protection, wear a jacket and pants that cover your arms and legs completely.

questions.question: What is a danger of riding next to parked cars?

options.text: You may not find a parking spot.
A driver may pull out suddenly into your path.
Other drivers may go slowly while looking for parking.

questions.correctAnswerText: A driver may pull out suddenly into your path.
questions.explanation: A driver might pull out of a parking space without looking. Car doors may open into your lane. Pedestrians may step out from between cars.

questions.question: What is the best gear to wear when riding?
questions.explanation: Wear gear that protects you. Use a DOT-approved helmet, face or eye protection, and protective clothing.

questions.question: Which item is NOT protective clothing for a motorcycle rider?
questions.explanation: Riders should wear a helmet, eye protection, a jacket, long pants, sturdy boots, and gloves.

questions.question: Which fabric gives the most protection to motorcyclists?
questions.explanation: Leather jackets and pants provide the most protection when riding.

questions.question: On which surface does a motorcycle have the best traction?
questions.explanation: Poor traction surfaces include wet pavement, gravel, sand, mud, snow, ice, painted lane markings, and metal plates. Dry pavement is the safest.

questions.question: Which item does NOT protect a motorcycle rider?

options.text: Boots that go over the ankle

questions.explanation: Wear a DOT-approved helmet, face or eye protection, a sturdy jacket and long pants, high sturdy boots, and durable gloves.

questions.question: Which item does NOT need regular checking?
questions.explanation: Before every ride, check your tires, controls, chains, sprockets, shock absorbers, fasteners, and brakes. Small mechanical problems can be very dangerous.

questions.question: A motorcycle fits you if:

options.text: You can touch your feet to the ground while seated.
You can reach the controls by stretching.
The handlebars go over your head.
Your feet cannot rest on the foot pegs.

questions.correctAnswerText: You can touch your feet to the ground while seated.
questions.explanation: A motorcycle fits properly if your feet can touch the ground while seated. You should be able to easily reach and use the controls.

questions.question: When should you use a turn signal?

options.text: When you plan to speed up.
Any time you plan to change lanes.

questions.correctAnswerText: Any time you plan to change lanes.
questions.explanation: Use a turn signal every time you turn or change lanes, even if you think no one is watching.

questions.question: What footwear is best for a motorcycle operator?
questions.explanation: Sturdy boots or high shoes that support your ankles provide the best protection. High-top boots or heavy shoes work well. Tuck in long laces before riding.

questions.question: Motorcycle gloves are usually:
questions.explanation: Motorcycle gloves are usually made of leather. They improve your grip and protect your hands and fingers.

questions.question: Your main source of information about your motorcycle should be:
questions.explanation: Your owner's manual is your best source for information about your specific motorcycle. It includes details about how it works, its features, and recommended maintenance.

questions.question: A DOT-approved helmet:

options.text: Can greatly reduce head injury severity.
Makes it harder to control your motorcycle.

questions.correctAnswerText: Can greatly reduce head injury severity.
questions.explanation: Wearing a helmet greatly reduces the risk of serious head and neck injuries in a crash. A DOT-approved helmet will not block your side vision.

questions.question: A motorcycle rider can improve their visibility by:
questions.explanation: To be seen by other drivers, wear bright clothing with reflective material. Also use your headlight at all times and use your signals and brake light properly.

questions.question: Slippery surfaces make it hard to control a motorcycle. Which is a slippery surface?
questions.explanation: Wet pavement, loose gravel, sand, mud, snow, ice, painted lines, and metal covers in the road are slippery. Ride with extra caution on slippery surfaces.
